title: CatalogDraftChanged v1 payload
description: A brand's draft menu changed (ADR 0016, ADR 0137, ADR 0138): which entity and how, never what it became. The draft moved; nothing a customer is served did until it is published. Identifiers, an entity kind and a change code only: no name, no price, no URL, no personal data (ADR 0029). Several writes to one entity in one transaction are one fact.

entityType.description: The kind of entity that changed: PRODUCT, VARIANT, CATEGORY, CATALOG, MODIFIER_GROUP, MODIFIER_OPTION, ... A stable code, not a class name.

entityId.description: The entity, or null for a batch that spans many (a bulk classification).

channelId.description: The sales channel the change is scoped to (a channel override or offering), or null when it is the draft's own.
